newsitem.title: USA: N.Y.S. Dormitory Authority plans March bond sale.
newsitem.headline: N.Y.S. Dormitory Authority plans March bond sale.

text.p: The New York State Domitory Authority plans to sell in March around $82.4 million of bonds for the State University of New York, an Authority official said on Friday.
"At the earliest, it would be sometime in March," said the official, who declined to be named, adding the sale likely would be done through negotiation.

The state Public Authorities Control Board on Wednesday approved the offering, along with an $18.15 million refunding St. Mary's Hospital of Amsterdam, and a $6.2 million bond sale for the state Education Department's Cultural Educational Center.
The $18.15 million refunding likely will be sold in late February through negotiation. While PaineWebber has been selected to lead the syndicate, no other members of the team have been picked.
And the $6.2 million offering is expected to be sold through competition in mid-February, the official added.
